bayts.text: And be gentle with Your servant, the Servant (al-Khadīm), and turn toward others than him what grieves him, that it may depart.
And grant him a beautiful kindness, and grant him his desire without fear.
And direct, by the standing of the Chosen, to the community a relief that spares it harm and distress.
There is none for the community of the Prophet but You, O One Who have multiplied Your gift for me.
To You is my turning on this day: I ask Your good for the best of communities.
Direct (Your relief) to the community of the Prophet, the accepted Intercessor — bless him —, freeing it from the cannon.
And free them, through You, from sins, and spare them the harm of every disobedient one.
And bless, O Subtle, O One, O Guide (Al-Hādī), the best of the obedient, who was guided,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today, by the right of Allah — glory be to Him — and by the Messenger of Allah,
after Your blessing upon him with peace, on my behalf, the gifts of the Beautiful and peace,
without affectation or wavering, O best of providers and best of hosts.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "Generous" (Al-Karīm) and "Benefiter" (An-Nāfiʿ),
bless with a blessing that draws noble virtues to my character and drives forbidden things
toward other than my heart and my form together, upon him who has gathered the best distinctions,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And lead to him the best peace that does not fade, that leads to me from You my desire, O Generous,
without harm, nor heartache, nor illness, nor enemies, and that makes the aim good for me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "Compassionate" (Ar-Raʾūf) and "Most Merciful" (Ar-Raḥīm),
bless with a blessing that makes time good and makes security everlasting for me, until Eternity,
with a peace that protects from unbelief and its people, O You Who have gifted forgiveness,
upon him through whom You made me inherit the Book, and who drove reproach away from me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make through him my verses a source of gladness for him, and accept piety from me.
And forgive my parents, O Possessor of mercy, and grant them, Lord, mercy from You.
And set piety right with the correction of the All-Knowing, and make, Lord, my breast a spring of sciences.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "Loving" (Al-Wadūd) and "Glorious" (Al-Majīd),
bless with a blessing that draws to me affection, good pleasure, truthfulness and succours,
with a peace that drives depravity toward others than us and illumines a market for me,
upon him whose service has driven misery toward others than us and granted us triumph.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make, by his mighty standing, my writing the highest of Your good pleasure: You have already given rest to my mount.
To me You have led what I used to long for, drawing it, O You Who spared me slander and lying.
O You Who spared me misery and envy, and did not turn enviers toward my directions,
O You Who have given me rest from Satan and from every troubler in my lands,
bless with a blessing that bears witness to my gratitude, with a peace that bears witness to my success,
upon him who drove whoever willed what grieves me toward others than me, (he) unique (in this).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward him on my behalf with a good that has been for none but him, and be pleased with the Companions with "Be".
And reward them on my behalf with a good that does not fade, O Enricher Who lead to me what I long for.
And make my letters, through him, Your good pleasure, O You Who were pleased with him since he pleased You.
O You from Whom, through him, the sacred months have come to me with my wishes, and Muḥarram has increased (them) for me,
bless with a blessing that never ceases to lead to the Prophet of Allah the best benefit,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
and grant him peace in all (the months), O best Enricher, Benefiter, All-Hearing,
just as You made him chief of the Messengers, master of every angel and Messenger.
O You Who protected me from an enemy and from travel (safar), and led Your good things to me (in the month of) Ṣafar,
bless with a blessing that never ceases to bring in joy, with peace, arriving honey-sweet,
into the heart of him who does not resemble mankind in form, in character and in abundance of glad tidings.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
